_comment: Maps each agent to the skills it leverages. All listed skills are candidates — the installer filters to only those actually installed for the user's tech stack.

planner.reason: Planner uses strategic-compact for structured thinking, coding-standards to know what to plan for, and stack-specific patterns to generate relevant task breakdowns.

architect.reason: Architect uses architecture-copilot for ADR templates and design patterns, plus stack-specific skills to make version-aware design decisions.

tdd-guide.reason: TDD Guide uses tdd-workflow as its core process, plus the language/framework-specific testing skill for the user's tech stack.

code-reviewer.reason: Code Reviewer enforces coding-standards and security-review, plus stack-specific pattern skills to catch framework-specific anti-patterns.

security-reviewer.reason: Security Reviewer uses security-review as its core checklist, ai-governance for AI-related risks, and framework-specific security skills for targeted checks.

build-error-resolver.reason: Build Error Resolver uses coding-standards to understand correct patterns, verification-loop to confirm fixes, and stack-specific skills to diagnose framework errors.

doc-updater.reason: Doc Updater uses coding-standards to write consistent doc comments and api-design for accurate API documentation.

e2e-runner.reason: E2E Runner uses e2e-testing for Playwright/Cypress patterns, verification-loop to structure test validation, and frontend-patterns for UI-aware selectors.

refactor-cleaner.reason: Refactor Cleaner uses coding-standards as the target state, verification-loop to confirm no regressions, and stack-specific skills to know which patterns to refactor toward.

database-reviewer.reason: Database Reviewer uses postgres-patterns for query and schema checks, database-migrations for migration safety, jpa-patterns for ORM-specific issues.
